Created [index.html](/private/tmp/pcd-sbx-codex-gpt-6.2-sol-vta5qowy/work/index.html) with the 40-second fight, deterministic replay, WebGL HUD, and synthesized audio.

- **Simulation** — 100,000 grass blades, 20,000 rain streaks, 143 boulders, and 80 binding arcs at normal charge. Each Verlet tether has 34 points, and the ragdoll has 15.
- **Simplifications** — The rig uses 14 bones and two articulated foot attachments. The camera uses lens shift and occasional widening to keep both subjects in frame.
- **Verified in Firefox** — The full replay and playback controls passed. Repeated scrubs matched pixel-for-pixel at 14 sampled times. I checked both viewport sizes and measured 60 fps in an eight-second sample at 1920×1080.
